item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini sinlendr-a bodhi kiged ǰin-a mitr-a-luγ-a, üǰegči yeke kelemürči bande yesisde orčiγulǰu nayiraγuluγad sin-e ǰasaγsan ayalgu-bar ǰasaǰu orusiγulbai, kunga odzer manǰusri mergen pandita-dur dulduyidču garm-a dubsang orusiγulbai, ene buyan-iyar qamuγ amitan eldeb buyan kiged belge bilig-ün čigalgan-i quriyaγad erkin buyan ba belge bilig-eče boluγsan erdeni degedü qoyar bey-e-yi olqu boltuγai

item.mng: qutuγ-tu manjusiri burqan-u ulus-un erdem jokiyaγsan neretü yeke kölgen sudur,
item.coloph: hindkeg-ün ubaḓini sinlen day-a bodi / kiged jina miḓr-a-luγa, nököčegči yeke kelemürči banḓi yesêsdi orčiγulǰu orčiγuluγad / sin-e ǰasaγsan ayalγu-bar ǰasaǰu orčiiγulbai. , . kunga odser mañǰusiri mergen bandida/-dur dulduyidču garm-a tübsang orčiγulbai. , . ma gq gha laṃ. bavanḓu / subam siri. saḓu eḓgü tegüsbe. , .
